grid.expression: SELECT ESE.CODPROD, SUM(CASE WHEN ESE.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 THEN ESE.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ESE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 THEN ESE.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS SALDO FROM TGFESE ESE INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (ESE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD) WHERE (ESE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL) AND ESE.CODLOCALORIG = :P_CODLOCALORIG AND ESE.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP AND TRUNC(ESE.DTREFERENCIA) <= :P_DTREFERENCIA AND PRO.USOPROD IN('B','C','1','2','I') GROUP BY ESE.CODPROD HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ESE.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 THEN ESE.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END)- SUM(CASE WHEN ESE.ATUALESTOQUE = -1 THEN ESE.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) <> 0 ORDER BY ESE.CODPROD
